newsitem.title: USA: Fresh America, Tom Lange end merger plans.
newsitem.headline: Fresh America, Tom Lange end merger plans.

text.p: Fresh America Corp said Monday that it and Tom Lange Co had decided not to go ahead with their merger plans, which were announced less than a month ago.
Fresh America, a food distribution management company, said it would keep looking for possible mergers despite the decision.

"We are actively seeking other ways to maximize our growth potential, including acquisitions and alliances that offer synergy with our existing operations, maximize utilization of our distribution network and capabilities, and represent both efficient use of capital and profitable growth," it said.
On July 1, the company said it had entered a tentative agreement to acquire Tom Lange, an employee-owned produce sales and distribution company.
Fresh America did not disclose the reason behind its decision not to merge with the company and its spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
